_comment_model: Switch backbone here, then re-run: python setup.py --model <hf_id> [--device cuda]. For ESMC-6B use a GPU environment and the Biohub esm package.
_comment_dataset: Grouped idv-level dataset. Each sample is a list of spidroin sequences associated with one fiber/property idv.
_comment_target_mode: raw = toughness/E/strength/strain in physical units, standardized inside training. norm = use toughnessNorm/ENorm/strengthNorm/strainNorm.
_comment_category_dim: 0 disables category embeddings in the starting baseline. Agents may set >0 and use category_ids in model.py.
_note: Autoresearch should edit model.py and optionally config.json. The fixed problem is set-of-sequences -> fiber mechanics.
